column1: # GIAB Ashkenazim trio, Oslo University Hospital exome (2015).
# THE FASTQ PATHS POINT AT results/, NOT data/, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
# GIAB publishes no FASTQ for these exomes -- the only Illumina exome data for
# HG002/HG003/HG004 is a position-sorted, duplicate-marked BAM. Those BAMs are
# downloaded by hand into data/giab_trio/ (see the README) and reverted to paired
# FASTQ by rule revert_bam_to_fastq, which writes here. common.smk deliberately
# skips its FASTQ-existence check for paths under results/ so that generated reads
# are a supported input, exactly as for the smoke test.
# Capture kit is Agilent SureSelect V5, for which no public target BED exists
# (Agilent gates them behind a SureDesign account). config/giab_trio.yaml scores
# these against the Twist Exome v2 BED as a documented PROXY -- see the comments
# there before reading the recall numbers.
# One lane each (L008), one library each, so `library` is the library name from
# the source filename rather than a fabricated per-unit value.
